materials.topic: 大件闲置：能用不等于有人接
materials.text: 赵先生的椭圆仪能正常运转，家里有电梯。挂二手平台几个月无人问津，回收商不收，最后倒付70元请人清走。记者看到买家先问在哪、有没有电梯、能不能帮搬。回收商要承担仓储运输人工成本。

source.evidence_text: 赵先生的椭圆仪能正常运转，家里有电梯。挂二手平台几个月无人问津，回收商不收，最后倒付70元请人清走。记者看到买家先问在哪、有没有电梯、能不能帮搬。回收商要承担仓储运输人工成本。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T23:34:20Z
今年上半年，北京市民赵先生打算处理家里闲置的椭圆仪。他先联系厂家，对方表示不提供回收服务；把信息挂到二手交易平台，几个月时间无人问津；又辗转找到专做家具、健身器材回收的商家，得到的答复同样是“不收”。
赵先生家住南四环，楼层不高且有电梯，搬运物品并不困难，可即便如此，这台仍能正常运转的椭圆仪，始终找不到合适的人接手。最终，他只能找来一位收废品的师傅，倒付70元，才把这件“大件”从家里清了出去。
记者浏览二手交易平台发现，在不少大件家具交易帖文下，买家最关注的问题往往不是价格，而是“在哪个地方”“有没有电梯”“能不能帮忙搬”。对于跨区域交易而言，运输成本更成为难以绕开的障碍；即便是同城交易，大件旧物也往往需要专业工具和多人协作才能完成搬运，而这些额外成本，很容易超过商品本身的价值。由此也导致大件旧物在二手交易平台很难卖出——买家不愿意承担运输成本，卖家包运送的话售价就要大幅上涨，导致买卖双方难以达成交易合意。
多位受访从业者向记者表示，对于回收企业而言，回收一件大件旧物并不意味着能够立即实现价值转化。在等待交易、拆解或再利用的过程中，仓储、运输和人工成本仍在持续产生。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T06:00:19Z
After Catherine Warrilow sold a Zara necklace for £6 on Vinted, she packed it up and posted it off, just as she had done with many things before. Only this time the buyer claimed the parcel arrived empty.
Warrilow, 47, from Oxford, provided Vinted with photos and videos of the package, including date-stamped Ring doorbell footage of her leaving the house to post it. But she says the resale platform refunded the buyer and left her out of pocket.
“I challenged Vinted on what evidence they had and asked them to supply it, but they simply said ‘based on our evidence’ and ‘our evidence suggests’ and could not explain what that was,” she says. “The photos from the buyer showed that all of the parcel tape I’d used had been removed.”
According to Vinted, all appeals are handled by human reviewers, including Warrilow’s cases.

materials.topic: 误投信箱后的长期互助
materials.text: 村民曾拆门板抬受伤的王保贵就医，还凑钱帮他养伤。1976年邮递员误把他家信箱当全村公用信箱，他便义务送报送信，延续50年。年轻时步行，现在骑三轮车。他还自费订农业报刊，复印核桃种植技术给村民。

source.evidence_text: 村民曾拆门板抬受伤的王保贵就医，还凑钱帮他养伤。1976年邮递员误把他家信箱当全村公用信箱，他便义务送报送信，延续50年。年轻时步行，现在骑三轮车。他还自费订农业报刊，复印核桃种植技术给村民。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T15:26:01Z
1968年，一场意外事故令王保贵右臂受重伤。危急关头，全村人自发赶来，有人撕衣包扎，有人拆下门板做成担架，众人接力把他送往医院，使他保住一条命。
养伤期间，村民和同事自发捐款，一毛、两毛凑钱帮助他渡过难关。这份情谊，他一直铭记于心。从那时起，他便下定决心，要用实际行动回馈乡里。
1976年，邮递员误把他家信箱当成全村公用信箱，家里常堆满别人的报刊和信件，王保贵没有置之不理，主动担起义务投递的担子，这一干就是整整50年。“早年身体好，我靠步行投递；现在年纪大了，我骑三轮车送报。”王保贵说。
近年来，村里发展核桃种植产业，王保贵自费订阅农业科技类报刊，把有关核桃种植的技术内容复印下来，分发到村民手中。由于经常送报，王保贵成了村民眼里“最可信的人”，就连大学录取通知书、汇款单等，村民也都放心托付他代收。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-09-10T00:00:00Z
The first specimen was unearthed in the late 1990s by Dr Burkhard Pohl, founder of the Wyoming Dinosaur Center, after he spotted a belemnite much bigger than any he had seen before. The fossil sat unstudied in the museum's collection draw for many years until a second specimen was discovered by fossil collector Cliff Linster near Ten Sleep, Wyoming, and donated to the Wyoming Dinosaur Center in 2019. Together, the two fossils provided the evidence needed to identify and formally describe the new species. 
The name Wyoteuthis translates to “a squid from Wyoming”, while the species name, linsterorum , honours Cliff Linster and his family. Cliff discovered one of only two known specimens of the new species and donated it for scientific study. Cliff Linster passed away in June this year. He knew researchers were studying his remarkable discovery and was excited to see it formally described.

The record-breaking heat in London, in summer 2022, resulted in an appalling problem in my neighbourhood – which one man took on, armed only with a jet wash. My neighbour disappeared briefly, and returned carrying a jet washer. There was splat, a yell and a blossom of what looked like rice grains were blasted into the air.
Maggots. Hundreds – maybe even thousands – of maggots, propelled into flight and falling on windows, walls, cars, gardens, hedges, pavements and bins all around. I thanked the universe I’d kept my window closed, as they landed on the windowsill, still wriggling their last wriggle. Some neighbours obviously thought that rain had finally come in the form of hail. They opened their doors to see. And then they too were hit by the unfolding horror.
There stood the neighbour, stray maggots in his hair and on his face, before he went inside to fetch the dustpan and brush.

据黄炯回忆，闲聊时，柏大卫总爱提起少年趣事：放羊放牛、下河游泳，和伙伴在田埂偷拔萝卜，被农户追得四处跑。讲完总笑着自嘲：“当年我也当了一回‘贼娃子’(湟源话，小偷)。”

“中国观众对我的态度，让我感受到了不一样的温暖，这是我人生中独一无二的体验。”近日，意大利街头艺术家Marco以“但丁爷爷”的造型亮相河南开封万岁山武侠城，开启中国首秀。他独特的造型和表演吸引游客驻足观看、拍照互动。

The method
 
 Use clean, sharp scissors and cut along the leaf’s natural shape. Leave a thin sliver of the brown edge rather than cutting into the healthy green tissue, which would create a fresh wound that the plant then has to seal off, causing it to go brown again in the process.
The test
 
 I trimmed the brown tips on a philodendron, following the leaf shape, and the leaves immediately looked neater and, over time, didn’t brown further along the cut. On an earlier attempt years ago, I cut back into the green part of the leaf and watched a new brown edge form within days.

In one of the biggest surprises of NASA's OSIRIS-REx mission, its target asteroid, Bennu, turned out to be a jagged, rugged world covered in large boulders, with few of the smooth patches that earlier observations from Earth-based instruments had indicated.
Ryan's team scrutinized rock particles collected from Bennu’s surface using a variety of laboratory analysis techniques. In a study published in Nature Communications the authors reported that the boulders are indeed porous enough to account for some of the observed heat loss, but not all of it. Rather, many of the rocks turned out to be riddled with extensive networks of cracks.
“The sample goes into its own ‘spacesuit,’ gets a CT scan, and then comes back to its pristine environment, all without having any exposure to the terrestrial environment,” said Nicole Lunning, lead OSIRIS-REx sample curator within the Astromaterials Research and Exploration Science division at NASA Johnson and one of the study's co-authors. “We can image right through these airtight containers to visualize the shape and internal structure of the rock that's inside.”
